tasks.title: Svelte + Vite project scaffold
tasks.description: Initialize web/ directory with Svelte 5, Vite, and Tailwind CSS v4. Configure vite.config.js to output to web/dist/. Create index.html, src/main.js, src/App.svelte, src/app.css.

tasks.title: API client module
tasks.description: Create web/src/lib/api.js with fetch wrappers for all virtual-model endpoints and metadata/fields. Handle auth header, error responses, and base URL configuration.

tasks.title: Svelte stores and field definitions
tasks.description: Create web/src/lib/stores.js with writable stores (virtualModels, metadataFields, selectedVM, adminKey, toasts). Create web/src/lib/fields.js with predicate type matrix mapping field types to operators and value input types.

tasks.title: Metadata fields API endpoint
tasks.description: Create internal/api/handlers/metadata_handler.go with GET /api/v1/metadata/fields handler. Returns field definitions (name, type, description, min, max, values) from models.json. Mount route in internal/api/router.go.

tasks.title: FieldSelector component
tasks.description: Create web/src/components/FieldSelector.svelte. Dropdown of metadata fields grouped by type (Numeric, String, Boolean). Receives fields array as prop, emits selected field. Shows field description on hover.

tasks.title: OperatorSelector component
tasks.description: Create web/src/components/OperatorSelector.svelte. Shows operators appropriate for the selected field type. Number: eq/neq/gt/gte/lt/lte. String with values: eq/neq/in. String general: eq/neq/contains. Boolean: eq/neq.

tasks.title: ValueInput component
tasks.description: Create web/src/components/ValueInput.svelte. Type-aware value input: numeric slider/input for numbers, dropdown for string with known values, multi-select chips for 'in' operator, text input for general strings, toggle for booleans.

tasks.title: ConditionBuilder and SortBuilder
tasks.description: Create ConditionBuilder.svelte: list of condition rows (field+operator+value), add/remove buttons, visual summary text, outputs filter_expr JSON. Create SortBuilder.svelte: list of sort criteria, direction toggle or custom order mode, drag-to-reorder, outputs sort_expr JSON.

tasks.title: ResolvedPreview component
tasks.description: Create web/src/components/ResolvedPreview.svelte. Calls GET /api/v1/virtual-models/{id}/resolved. Shows priority-ordered list with position, provider/model, compact tag display [int=85, code=78, spd=80]. Color-coded by priority.

tasks.title: VirtualModelForm (create/edit)
tasks.description: Create web/src/components/VirtualModelForm.svelte. Combines name input, ConditionBuilder, SortBuilder, max_retries input, retry_on_status multi-select. Handles both create and edit modes. Submits to API, shows ResolvedPreview after save.

tasks.title: VirtualModelList view
tasks.description: Create web/src/components/VirtualModelList.svelte. Table with name, filter summary, sort summary, action buttons. Create New button. Click to expand ResolvedPreview inline. Delete triggers ConfirmDialog.

tasks.title: ConfirmDialog and Toast components
tasks.description: Create ConfirmDialog.svelte for delete confirmation modal. Create Toast.svelte for success/error notifications. Create LoginPrompt.svelte for admin API key entry with localStorage persistence.

tasks.title: Go embed and SPA serving
tasks.description: Modify cmd/llm-router/main.go to add //go:embed web/dist directive. Modify internal/api/router.go to serve SPA: index.html for non-API GET requests, static files from embedded FS for /assets/* paths.

tasks.title: Build script
tasks.description: Add Makefile or build script that runs 'cd web && npm install && npm run build' then 'go build ./cmd/llm-router'. Document build process in README.

tasks.title: Dark theme and responsive layout
tasks.description: Apply dark theme matching the TUI aesthetic. Ensure responsive layout works on desktop and tablet viewports. Style all components with Tailwind.

tasks.title: Update architecture and techstack specs
tasks.description: Update specs/architecture.json to add Web UI Layer node. Update specs/techstack.json to add Svelte, Vite, Tailwind CSS entries.
